# Build manifest (dry run N1)

The toy product of neoProcess's dry run (lane-neoprocess/DRYRUN.md). Its root is the repository root; pass `.` as `<product>` to every `neo` command.

## Canon

`requirements/README.md` indexes it; `build/areas.md` names each area's canon, modules, rulebook and lane.

## Tests

Each module's tests: `node --test <module>/test/*.test.mjs` from the root. No layer tests.

## Generated artifacts (regenerated by the gate for its run, committed only at a layer's close)

| artifact | owned by | regenerate | verify |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beta/dist/bundle.txt` | beta | `node beta/scripts/bundle.mjs` | `node beta/scripts/bundle.mjs --verify` |
| `legacy/dist/legacy.bundle.txt` | legacy (no job) | `node legacy/scripts/bundle.mjs` | `node legacy/scripts/bundle.mjs --verify` |

## Situations

None: the toy has no release, deploy or walk. Object storage: none (no captures).

## ROOT

The dry run's BOB is started by Bob's ROOT on his account (SESSIONS §1).
